testsOnlyRed.message: test: expose macro location and expansion defects

implementation.message: fix: preserve macro token origins and rescanning

dashboardReceipt.message: docs: publish a clean kernel front-end dashboard

reasons: same-file macro tag violated the ordered SourceSpan invariant
header macro tag retained the header spelling extent instead of the invocation extent
expanded attribute text came from a source-buffer slice and produced t instead of 8

stringizationWhitespace.reason: stringization inserted spaces before every expanded token instead of reproducing preprocessing-token whitespace

outerSequenceRescanning.reason: the replacement-list boundary left smp followed by parentheses instead of rescanning the joined outer sequence to Z

implementationFacts: Each token retains spelling_span and an expansion span; lexer spelling text is materialized on the token.
Parser node-span composition is total: ordered same-file spans extend, otherwise the first token expansion span is retained.
Parser contextual text comes from token spelling and never from indexing an unrelated source buffer.
Stringization uses the preprocessing-token whitespace flag.
Rescanning may join a replacement-list result with the actual following parenthesized invocation while the current macro remains disabled.

acceptanceDiffGuard.qualification: This dashboard is the required regression guard. The raw-to-EvoCPP-to-parser integration claim is established separately by the full-configuration survey.

fullConfigurationSurvey.scopeDiscipline: The rerun was measure-only; none of its typed diagnostic frontier was fixed.

processDeviations: The hidden expected invocation column in one token-location assertion was corrected from 35 to the measured 34 during GREEN; the RED run had already failed on expanded text before reaching that assertion.

A sandboxed base-layout attempt could not inspect the sealed container image and was rejected. The authoritative base and attributed corpora were rerun sequentially with the required container permission.

The first dashboard attempt was rejected before measurement because the sandbox could not inspect the sealed image. A second attempt measured all 48 lanes clean but the publisher rejected a relative evidence path at final receipt construction. The accepted publication used the same subject and an absolute evidence path.
claimCeiling: The token-location, stringization-whitespace, and outer-sequence-rescan obligations pass. The full survey has zero panic, timeout, or unavailable units; its 1540 diagnosed units are an open typed frontier, not general parser conformance.
